reviews.comment: she's a great choice for micro! Nice and understanding! 4 midterms and a final, and lab had 3 lab exams, so it was a lot but not too bad. pay attention to lectures and write down her extra notes she writes on her slides. tests not bad, DO THE STUDY Qs! also has practice exams. lab hw due twice a week, one lab report at the end. study hard for lab
Dr. Siegele is a kind professor who is very knowledgeable about the material she lectures over. She is very patient with students and gives thorough answers to questions.

She's a really reasonable and understanding prof. Her grading materials are clear and she is actually aware of what her students are capable of. Only reason I didn't get an A is because I didn't study as much as I should have. Lab is a little difficult at first, but it gets much easier. Solid choice for micro bio

Dr. Siegele is an amazing professor, she cares about students, and she is great at teaching. Her class is not easy, you have to pay attention to what she says during lectures bc ppt aren't enough. Study questions are important so do them! Try to do practice exams before hand, def helps getting A's. Lab is tedious but doable. She's amazing!

Professor Siegele is great, She makes expectations clear and provides great feedback. She's also accessible outside the class. Study questions are important so do them for sure. Take her and work hard on the lab as the lab can be really hard if you do not pay attentions during experiments.

Dr. Siegele is one of the nicest teachers I've had at TAMU. However, her lecturing skills are not the best. She talks a bit slow and doesn't go into enough detail. Also, the slides she posts on online will not be enough to pass... you NEED notes from class. Overall, exams are fair and reflect the study questions.

reviews.comment: Siegele is the best science prof I've ever had. She truly wants her students to learn and structures her class to show it. Tests are very fair and she gives study questions. the book just helps elaborate sometimes. Lab is tedious, but she is so great. Went to her office hours and she was SO helpful. Take her! Very doable A and you actually learn!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Siegele made microbiology worth going to. She breaks down the learning objectives into smaller pieces so they can be easily understood. For the exams, she gives out study guides that are extremely helpful and posts old exams on Ecampus. Not to mention that she wears these cat pins on her shirts in lecture that make me smile.

Dr. Siegele is so genuine and cares so much about teaching this course, she is very willing to work with you and help you understand concepts if you go to office hours! This class is difficult though, and the lab is a lot of work! Recommend using the book to help you
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Siegele is AMAZING. She is so knowledgeable about microbiology and presents the information in a clear, easy to understand manner. She also posts extremely helpful study guides for her tests. The lab has a lot of assignments, but they're very doable. This was by far one of my favorite profs. I cannot recommend her enough!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class/lab combination is not hard, but you must be willing to put in a lot of work. Lecture was pretty easy, but lab was just a ridiculous amount of work. The work is easy, though, so it may be a grade booster in the end if you're borderline A/B or B/C. Dr. Siegele was very nice and fair in grading!

This course had 4 lecture exams, 3 lab exams, and a final. Lecture was very easy to follow, but ALL of her test questions came from lecture so you must go to class! Recording her lectures really helped!! Lab was a lot of work as there was a quiz and several assignments were due every lab session (2x a week). Be prepared for a lot of work but doable
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr. Siegele was a good professor! She is extremely intelligent and is really excited to teach every lecture. You can tell she genuinely cares about her students. I went to her office hours several times throughout the semester and she was always willing to talk and explain concepts to me. Study her study questions she gives out!

reviews.comment: Take this professor!! You will learn A LOT and she truly cares about her students. Lab is the hardest part about the class because it requires a lot of work. Her study questions are a good representation of her exams but also skim through the book if you don't go to class. I really enjoyed her class and recommend her to everyone.
Sieglie obviously cared about the topics she lectured and was vary fair in grading of exams. Her review sessions were also very useful. She seemed inspired to teach the class. Great prof.
